name: Neko no Onee-chan ga Oshiete Kureta Koto
original_name: ネコのお姉ちゃんが教えてくれたコト
source:
The protagonist is a rich little boy who lives a lonely life: his mother died when he was younger while his father is always on business trips and himself doesn't have any friends at school. Luckily, his sole source of companionship is his pet cat who is always with him, but tragically died during a run over.
A ground keeper tells him an old tale that someone buried a dead dog near a lake, and the dog resurrected the next day. Taking this to heart, the grieving protagonist does the same thing with his cat, but nothing happens.
Thereafter, a mysterious woman named Azuki makes an apparition in his life, as his guardian and surrogate sister.
translation:
主角是一个富有的小男孩，过着孤独的生活：他的母亲在他很小的时候就去世了，他的父亲经常出差，他自己在学校没有任何朋友。幸运的是，他唯一的陪伴来源是他的宠物猫，这只猫一直陪伴着他，但在一次碾压中不幸身亡。
一位场地管理员告诉他一个古老的故事，有人把一只死狗埋在湖边，第二天那只狗就复活了。悲伤的主角牢记这一点，对他的猫做了同样的事情，但什么也没发生。
此后，一位名叫小豆的神秘女子出现在他的生活中，成为他的监护人和代理妹妹。
